title: Profiling of epithelial functional states and fibroblast phenotypes in hormone therapy-naïve localised prostate cancer

documents_reviewed.file_name: DOI_10.1101_2024.10.23.619925_Profiling of epithelial functional states and fibroblast phenotypes in hormone therapy-naïve localis.pdf
documents_reviewed.notes: 包含正文、图 1-5、方法、补充图引用及讨论，共 64 页

cluster_inventory.clustering_level: 主要细胞大类聚类 (Major cell class annotation)
cluster_inventory.population: 局限性前列腺癌及癌旁良性组织穿刺活检细胞 (24位患者，46个核心样本，共58,956细胞)
cluster_inventory.tissue_condition: 激素治疗初治前列腺组织 (ISUP 2-5 肿瘤及邻近良性核心)
cluster_inventory.coverage_notes: 全局无监督聚类后经细胞谱系特征基因注释为 11 个主要大类，其中上皮、成纤维、平滑肌和神经胶质细胞为重点解析谱系

cluster_inventory.clustering_level: 上皮谱系细分与亚群聚类 (Epithelial subset clustering)
cluster_inventory.tissue_condition: 前列腺癌及癌旁良性上皮组织
cluster_inventory.coverage_notes: 上皮细胞重聚类鉴定出25个亚群，归入Basal, Club, Luminal, Luminal-like, Club-IFN, Ciliated, NE七类细分谱系

cluster_inventory.clustering_level: 成纤维细胞与CAF细分聚类 (Fibroblast minor annotation)
cluster_inventory.coverage_notes: 基于功能状态与解剖相互作用解析为6个CAF细分亚型，包括新型神经周围pnCAFs及通用型uniCAFs

cluster_inventory.clustering_level: 平滑肌与壁细胞细分聚类 (SMC & mural minor annotation)
cluster_inventory.population: 平滑肌及壁细胞群体 (6,709 cells)
cluster_inventory.tissue_condition: 前列腺平滑肌间质与微血管壁
cluster_inventory.source_locator: Main Text p. 22-23; Supp. Fig. S13
cluster_inventory.coverage_notes: 区分出前列腺特异收缩平滑肌、血管平滑肌、周细胞及干扰素应答平滑肌
